items.name: Solving in Sedgefield 2025
items.information: **Welcome to Solving in Sedgefield 2025!** **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.
